Sound familiar? ↓

Your content isn’t the problem. The edit is.

Most creators don’t have a content problem. They have an editing problem, and it quietly costs them views, followers and time.

  • Hours of footage sitting on your drive, waiting for a free weekend that never comes.
  • Four hours on one video, and it still doesn’t look like the creators you follow.
  • You only post when you find time to edit, so your page goes quiet for weeks.
  • People scroll past in the first two seconds, so fewer people ever see your videos.
  • You hired an editor once. They missed the deadline, or stopped replying.

Here’s the fix

You record. I handle the rest.

Why people stop scrolling ↓

What goes into every edit

Four things I get right in every video, so it gets watched instead of skipped.

01

The 2-second hook

The first line of your video decides whether anyone sees the rest. I find your strongest moment and open with it.

02

Captions people actually read

Most people watch with the sound off. Word-by-word captions keep them following along until the end.

03

Pacing that holds attention

Long pauses and dead air are where viewers leave. I cut them out so your video keeps moving.

04

An ending that gets action

The last seconds tell viewers what to do next: follow, comment, or watch the next part.

What changes for you

  • Post every week without opening an editing app
  • Get your evenings and weekends back
  • Look as polished as the creators you look up to
  • Spend your time creating, not cutting

Hi, I’m Muhammad Ali

In 2023, I failed my exams. Instead of sitting them again, I taught myself video editing, one hook, caption and transition at a time.

The hardest part wasn’t the software. It was learning what makes people stop scrolling: a hook that grabs attention, text that moves with the voice, and b-roll that keeps the story going.

My first client was Real Funnels, and since then my edits have crossed 100K views. Today, from Ahmedpur East in Pakistan, I edit podcast clips and talking head videos for creators around the world.

Questions, answered

Everything you need to know before we start.

01How much does video editing cost?

Every project is different, so the price depends on the type of edit, the length of the video and how many videos you need. Your first video is 50% off, so you can try working with me first. Send me a message on WhatsApp or email and I’ll send you a clear price before we start.

02What if I don’t like my first edit?

Your first video comes with a money-back guarantee. If you’re not happy with it, tell me and you get your money back.

03How do I send my footage?

Upload your raw files to Google Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer and send me the link. I’ll let you know if anything is missing.

04How long does an edit take?

It depends on the length and type of video. I’ll confirm a delivery date with you before I start, so you always know when to expect it.

05Can I ask for changes?

Yes. You review the edit and tell me what to change. We agree on the number of revisions before starting, so there are no surprises.

06Do you edit podcast clips for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts?

Yes. Podcast clipping is one of my main services. I turn full episodes into short vertical clips with captions, ready to post on all three.

07Do you edit talking head videos?

Yes. I cut pauses and mistakes, add captions, zooms and b-roll, and keep the pacing tight so people keep watching.
